code: # Render another variant without editing the file: #   rmarkdown::render("electricity.Rmd", params = list(save_model = FALSE)) model_name <- "RENEURO_41" # Absolute paths (the PyPSA-Eur clone, the energyRt source tree) resolve from # environment variables; see data-raw/paths.R. source(file.path("data-raw", "paths.R"))  # energyRt and reneuro are loaded FROM SOURCE, not from the installed builds. # This matters: an installed energyRt that lags the source tree can normalise # vintage labels differently (NEW2025..NEW2050 collapsing to `new`) and then # reject this model at `update()` on a duplicate-key guard. suppressMessages({   pkgload::load_all(ENERGYRT_SRC, quiet = TRUE)   pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)   library(dplyr)   library(arrow) })  # `params` exists under rmarkdown::render(); default sensibly without it do_save <- if (exists("params")) isTRUE(params$save_model) else TRUE  # --- horizon ----------------------------------------------------------------- MILESTONES  <- seq(2025, 2050, 5) INVEST_FROM <- 2026    # 2025 is the anchor year: no new capacity is built in it # NOTE: double, not integer. `vintage$start` is a numeric column and an # integer assignment would change its stored type -- enough on its own to # give the model a different content hash.  # --- siting density (MW per km2) -------------------------------------------- # PyPSA-Eur's `capacity_per_sqkm`, inverted to km2/MW because the land pools # are denominated in area. Onshore wind 3, solar 5.1, single-axis tracking # 4.43 (config.default.yaml, `renewable:`); dual-axis 2.2 is the wider row # spacing tracking in two axes needs. WIN_KM2_PER_MW  <- 1 / 3 SOL_KM2_PER_MW  <- 1 / 5.1 HSAT_KM2_PER_MW <- 1 / 4.43 DUAL_KM2_PER_MW <- 1 / 2.2  # Dual-axis costs are not in the technology-data tables. Price them off # single-axis: take the hsat premium over fixed solar and multiply it, so # dual stays a fixed multiple of the tracking premium rather than of the # panel price. 2.5 is an assumption, not a source. DUAL_TRACKING_PREMIUM <- 2.5  # --- tier labels ------------------------------------------------------------- # The suffix on a technology name is its availability tier: wind by capacity # factor band (AF20 = CF >= 0.20), solar by level. WIN_TIER_LAB <- c(`1` = "AF20", `2` = "AF30", `3` = "AF40", `4` = "AF50") SOL_TIER_LAB <- c(`1` = "AF09", `2` = "AF11", `3` = "AF13", `4` = "AF15",                   `5` = "AF17", `6` = "AF19")  # --- wind power curve -------------------------------------------------------- WS_GRID <- seq(0, 60, by = 0.05)   # m/s; 60 is the curve's cut-out ceiling  # --- demand ------------------------------------------------------------------ DEMAND_SCENARIO <- "GA"   # TYNDP 2024: GA (Global Ambition) | NT | DE DEMAND_BASE     <- 2025  # --- resource layer ---------------------------------------------------------- # Built by data-raw/cf-workflow/ (4.8 GB, regenerable, gitignored). The heavy # sections below are skipped when it is not present on this machine. OUT    <- Sys.getenv("RENEURO_CF_OUT", "data-raw/cf-workflow/outputs") cf_ok  <- dir.exists(OUT) CS_DIR <- file.path(PYPSA_EUR_ROOT, "resources", "entsoe-2025") if (!cf_ok) message("resource layer absent: heavy chunks will be skipped") COSTS_Y <- lapply(stats::setNames(MILESTONES, MILESTONES), function(y) {   read.csv(file.path(CS_DIR, sprintf("costs_%d_processed.csv", y))) }) # fixom is split out of the annuity so economic retirement has something to # save: `eac_pure` is the capital charge alone. crow <- function(tech, y = 2050) {   r <- COSTS_Y[[as.character(y)]]   r <- r[r$technology == tech, ][1, ]   fom <- r$investment * r$FOM / 100   list(fom = fom, life = r$lifetime, eac = r$capital_cost,        eac_pure = r$capital_cost - fom) } str(crow("onwind")) #> List of 4 #>  $ fom     : num 15148 #>  $ life    : num 30 #>  $ eac     : num 118820 #>  $ eac_pure: num 103672

code: A <- merra2ools::fWindParkCurve(WS_GRID) mk_wind_fun <- function(s, curve_env) {   f <- function(weather, ...) {     stats::approx(V, A, pmin(s * weather, 60), yleft = 0, rule = 2)$y   }   environment(f) <- list2env(list(s = s), parent = curve_env)   f } mk_solar_fun <- function(s) {   f <- function(weather, ...) pmin(s * weather, 1)   environment(f) <- list2env(list(s = s), parent = baseenv())   f } slice_of <- function(tm) {   tm <- as.POSIXct(tm, tz = "UTC")   sprintf("d%03d_h%02d", as.integer(strftime(tm, "%j", tz = "UTC")),           as.integer(strftime(tm, "%H", tz = "UTC"))) } subset_regions <- function(obj, buses) {   for (s in c("capacity", "invcost", "fixom", "varom", "af", "afs")) {     d <- slot(obj, s)     if (is.data.frame(d) && nrow(d) && "region" %in% names(d)) {       slot(obj, s) <- d[is.na(d$region) | d$region %in% buses, , drop = FALSE]     }   }   obj }  # a template tech for the tiered family: structure from pypsa_eur_41's # blended object, costs year-keyed from the 41v open path, invest from 2026 vre_template <- function(carrier41, invkey) {   t <- tmpl41[[carrier41]]   # the un-vintaged template's all-NA year column is logical; the slot   # checker takes the current type as the expectation   t@invcost$year <- NA_integer_   t <- update(t, invcost = inv_y[[invkey]])   t@vintage$start <- INVEST_FROM   t@vintage$olife <- ol[[invkey]]   t }  # capacity rows: cap.up constant (year NA) + optional stock path rows. # Existing stock can exceed a tier's filtered potential (committed # capacity on land/sea the atlas floor removed -- the BE/DE/NL offshore # case): cap at cap.up and collect the shortfall for one report. .stock_shortfall <- new.env() cap_rows <- function(g, spath, share_col = "share", drop_up = FALSE) {   up <- data.frame(region = g$bus, year = NA_integer_, cap.up = g$cap_mw)   if (drop_up) up <- up[0, , drop = FALSE]   # bound moves to the land pool   if (is.null(spath)) return(up)   st <- g |> select(bus, cap_mw, share = all_of(share_col)) |>     inner_join(spath, by = c(bus = "region"),                relationship = "many-to-many") |>     mutate(alloc = stock * share, short = pmax(alloc - cap_mw, 0)) |>     transmute(region = bus, year, stock = pmin(alloc, cap_mw), short)   sh <- sum(st$short) / max(1, length(unique(st$year)))   if (sh > 0) {     if (is.null(.stock_shortfall$mw)) .stock_shortfall$mw <- 0     .stock_shortfall$mw <- .stock_shortfall$mw + sh   }   st <- st[st$stock > 0, c("region", "year", "stock"), drop = FALSE]   bind_rows(up, st) }

k <- g0$cluster[1]     sv <- streams |> filter(country == cc, cluster == k)     if (!nrow(sv)) next     buses <- sort(unique(g0$bus))     wnm <- sprintf("%s_%s_CL%d", wpfx, cc, k)     new_objs[[wnm]] <- newWeather(wnm, timeframe = "HOUR", region = buses,       weather = data.frame(region = rep(buses, each = 8760),                            timeslice = rep(slices, length(buses)),                            wval = rep(sv$cf, length(buses))))     for (tr_id in sort(unique(g0$tier))) {       g <- g0[g0$tier == tr_id, , drop = FALSE]       tr <- SOL_TIER_LAB[[as.character(tr_id)]]       lnm <- sprintf("LSOL_CL%d_%s", k, tr)       # the pool is created by the fixed-solar build; sharing it is the point       stopifnot(!is.null(LAND$pools[[lnm]]))       tb <- sort(unique(g$bus))       tech <- update(template,         name = sprintf("%s_%s_CL%d_%s", tpfx, cc, k, tr),         region = tb,         weather = data.frame(weather = wnm, waf.fx = 1),         capacity = empty_cap,         aux = data.frame(acomm = lnm, unit = "km2"),         aeff = data.frame(acomm = lnm, cap2ainp = km2_per_mw))       new_objs[[tech@name]] <- subset_regions(tech, tb)     }   }   new_objs } hsat_t <- vre_template("E_SOLAR_HSAT", "hsat") r_hsat <- mean(inv_y$hsat$eac) / mean(inv_y$solar$eac) dual_over_hsat <- (1 + DUAL_TRACKING_PREMIUM * (r_hsat - 1)) / r_hsat hsat_objs <- flat_variant_i("cluster_cf_hsat.parquet", hsat_t,                             HSAT_KM2_PER_MW, "W_SOLH", "E_SOLH") dual_objs <- flat_variant_i("cluster_cf_dual.parquet", hsat_t,                             DUAL_KM2_PER_MW, "W_SOLD", "E_SOLD",                             cost_factor = dual_over_hsat) cat(sprintf("hsat premium over fixed: %.2fx -> dual priced at %.2fx hsat\n",             r_hsat, dual_over_hsat)) #> hsat premium over fixed: 1.51x -> dual priced at 1.50x hsat

code: build_offshore_i <- function() {   streams <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(OUT, "cluster_ws_offshore.parquet"))   scales <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(OUT, "cluster_wscale_offshore.parquet"))   supply <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(OUT, "supply41_offshore.parquet"))   curves <- list(     fixed = read.csv(file.path(OUT, "offshore_curve_fixed.csv")),     float = read.csv(file.path(OUT, "offshore_curve_float.csv")))   mk_off_fun <- function(s, fam) {     cv <- curves[[fam]]     f <- function(weather, ...) {       stats::approx(V, A, s * weather, yleft = 0, yright = 0)$y     }     environment(f) <- list2env(list(s = s, V = cv$speed, A = cv$af),                                parent = baseenv())     f   }   af_off <- function(fam, tier) {     paste0(ifelse(fam == "float", "AFF", "AF"), 20 + 10 * tier)   }   shares <- supply |>     mutate(share = cap_mw / sum(cap_mw), .by = c(carrier, bus))   tmpl_off <- list(     `offwind-ac` = vre_template("E_OFFWIND_AC", "offwind-ac"),     `offwind-dc` = vre_template("E_OFFWIND_DC", "offwind-dc"),     `offwind-float` = vre_template("E_OFFWIND_FLOAT", "offwind-float"))   new_objs <- list()   slices <- slice_of(streams$time[streams$country == streams$country[1] &                                     streams$cluster == streams$cluster[1]])   for (grp in split(seq_len(nrow(scales)),                     paste(scales$country, scales$cluster))[          unique(paste(scales$country, scales$cluster))]) {     cc <- scales$country[grp[1]]; k <- scales$cluster[grp[1]]     rows <- shares |> filter(country == cc, cluster == k)     if (!nrow(rows)) next     buses <- sort(unique(rows$bus))     sv <- streams |> filter(country == cc, cluster == k)     stopifnot(nrow(sv) == 8760)     wnm <- sprintf("W_OFF_%s_CL%d", cc, k)     tfs <- list()     for (j in grp) {       tfs[[af_off(scales$fam[j], scales$tier[j])]] <-         mk_off_fun(scales$wscale[j], scales$fam[j])     }     w <- newWeather(wnm, timeframe = "HOUR", region = buses,                     weather = data.frame(                       region = rep(buses, each = 8760),                       timeslice = rep(slices, length(buses)),                       wval = rep(sv$ws, length(buses))))     w@misc$transform <- tfs     new_objs[[wnm]] <- w     for (cr in unique(rows$carrier)) {       fam <- ifelse(cr == "offwind-float", "float", "fixed")       for (ti in unique(rows$tier[rows$carrier == cr])) {         cap <- rows |> filter(carrier == cr, tier == ti)         tag <- af_off(fam, ti)         spath <- if (cr == "offwind-ac") paths$`offwind-ac` else NULL         tech <- update(tmpl_off[[cr]],           name = sprintf("E_OFF_%s_%s_CL%d_%s",                          toupper(sub("offwind-", "", cr)), cc, k, tag),           region = sort(unique(cap$bus)),           weather = data.frame(weather = wnm, transform = tag, waf.fx = 1),           capacity = cap_rows(cap, spath))         tech <- subset_regions(tech, sort(unique(cap$bus)))         new_objs[[tech@name]] <- tech       }     }   }   new_objs } off_objs <- build_offshore_i() if (!is.null(.stock_shortfall$mw)) {   message(sprintf(     "existing stock exceeds tier potential by ~%.1f GW total (capped at cap.up)",     .stock_shortfall$mw / 1e3)) }

code: flatten_stock <- function(t) {   cap <- t@capacity   s25 <- cap |> filter(!is.na(stock), year == 2025) |>     summarise(stock = sum(stock), .by = region)   keep <- cap |> filter(is.na(stock))   if (nrow(keep) && "vintage" %in% names(keep)) keep$vintage <- NA_character_   bind_rows(keep, s25 |> mutate(year = NA_integer_)) |> distinct() } # collapse a vintaged tech's vintage table to one neutral row (the # un-vintaged form: vintage NA; invest window and olife as given) one_vintage <- function(t, start = NA_integer_, olife = NA_real_) {   v <- t@vintage[1, , drop = FALSE]   v$vintage <- NA_character_   v$start <- as.integer(start)   v$end <- NA_integer_   v$olife <- olife   v } G1 <- c(E_NUCLEAR = "nuclear", E_GEOTHERMAL = "geothermal",         E_HYDRO = "hydro", E_ROR = "ror") for (nm in names(G1)) {   cr <- crow(G1[[nm]])   t <- objs[[nm]]   t@vintage <- one_vintage(t)   t@invcost <- t@invcost[0, , drop = FALSE]     # not investable   t <- update(t, capacity = flatten_stock(t),               fixom = data.frame(fixom = cr$fom))   objs[[nm]] <- t } G2 <- c(E_COAL = "coal", E_LIGNITE = "lignite", E_OIL = "oil",         E_BIOMASS = "biomass", E_WASTE = "waste") for (nm in names(G2)) {   cr <- crow(G2[[nm]])   t <- objs[[nm]]   iv <- t@invcost |> filter(!is.na(eac)) |>     transmute(region, year = as.integer(year), eac = eac - cr$fom) |>     distinct()   t@vintage <- one_vintage(t, start = INVEST_FROM, olife = cr$life)   t <- update(t, capacity = flatten_stock(t), invcost = iv,               fixom = data.frame(fixom = cr$fom))   t@optimizeRetirement <- TRUE   objs[[nm]] <- t } G2_GAS <- c(E_CCGT = "CCGT", E_OCGT = "OCGT") flatten_stock_v <- function(t, vlab = "STOCK") {   cap <- t@capacity   s25 <- cap |> filter(!is.na(stock), year == 2025) |>     summarise(stock = sum(stock), .by = region)   keep <- cap |> filter(is.na(stock))   # TOTAL cap.up rows keep their vintage   bind_rows(keep, s25 |> mutate(vintage = vlab, year = NA_integer_)) |>     distinct() } for (nm in names(G2_GAS)) {   cr <- crow(G2_GAS[[nm]])   t <- objs[[nm]]   iv <- t@invcost |> filter(!is.na(eac)) |>     transmute(vintage, region, eac = eac -
